name: Costa Rica
overview:
Pura vida. Hello, thanks, goodbye, and the answer to life itself. Costa Rica has somehow compressed an entire national mood into two words.

Literally translated as “pure life” or “simple life”, you’re sure to experience the pura vida vibe in the cloud forests and the culinary fares of Costa Rica.
